title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Orchid tells of hunting meownsters known as 'paperwork' on the daily. You hunt them as well, Doctor?

title: Talk 1
original: Yoshitsune, do mew remember how the Buddy Plaza looked? Yes, just a whisker of ink here—good, another chapter done! Deliver it to Spot for purr-usal! Ah, there really is no better way to reminisce than by illustrating the true tails of our homeland. How sharp Spot was to suggest this!

title: Talk 2
original: Having known Her Meowjesty Hofukaru, I'll say that Popukar is nothing alike! At first, the way she stared at me, I feared I'd offended her—my nights were sleepless! Eventually, I balled up the nerve to ask her, and lo and behold, she just wanted to pet me! We're such good friends meow, we even share the same bed!

title: Talk 3
original: Doctor, fur-give us! Yoshitsune almost clobbered Midnight in training! He briefly mistook the man fur our indomitable Shogun, and his reflexes kicked in—ah, not to imply your Midnight's a kitten in mittens, certainly not!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Catapult's gone again? I'll join Orchid in tracking her down! What? Yoshitsune, do you mean to stop me?! Purr-posterous, you're on Catapult's side?! So be it! It's mew or me! Let's duel!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: You want to learn the way of the Wirebug, Doctor? Very well! See the silk it secretes from its rear? Grab onto that, then aim in your desired direction, and throw—holey socks, the Doctor's gone flying! Quick, Yoshitsune, get ready to catch!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Mreep?! Mew'll be late for a meeting? Yoshitsune—Doctor, Yoshitsune's telling mew to get on! Now, word of warning, he's a fast runner, maybe too fast for your constitution—oh dear, and they're gone. Yes, I hear the Doctor caterwauling already. Oh well, I'll just have to deliver some medicine.

title: Idle
original: Yoshitsune, that's my tail you're lying on… mrow? Oh, it was the Doctor.

title: Onboard
original: Felicitations! We are Masamune and Yoshitsune of the Kamura Village Meowcenaries! Reconnaissance, material gathering, just leave it to us! Phew—compared to the bungled introduction we gave Her Meowjesty, that was perfect!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: That's right, every hunter worth their stripes has their own approach to combat!

title: Added to Squad
original: Hunting? Recon? Just leave it in our paws!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: It's purr-ime time to show what we're made of!

title: Depart
original: Begin quest!

title: Begin Operation
original: Doctor, Yoshitsune's caught the enemy's scent!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Yoshitsune says the enemy's prowling nearby!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Stay, Yoshitsune, stay!

title: Deployment 1
original: This is a job fur us!

title: Deployment 2
original: Let's find intel and materials to give the Doctor fuzzy feelings!

title: In Battle 1
original: Feast on eight paws' worth of Meowcenary might!

title: In Battle 2
original: Leave 'em chasing their own tails!

title: In Battle 3
original: You almost hit me, you fur-brain!

title: In Battle 4
original: We'll purr-loin good materials this time, I can feel it!

title: 4-star Result
original: What purr-fect command of such a hair-raising mission! You're as fine as the hunters of legend, Doctor!

title: 3-star Result
original: What rare materials did we get this time? I'm itching to know!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Doctor, stay vigilant! We still have enemies meowt and about!

title: Operation Failure
original: Cart's good to go! Whisk the Doctor out of here!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I wonder who's got the bigger steelworks? Rhodes Island, or Kamura Village?

title: Tap
original: Mrr-rauders?! Oh, it's mew, Doctor!

title: Trust Tap
original: You have some impawssibly complex contraptions aboard Rhodes Island…

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Yoshitsune, you feel it, don't you? Ten years since we left Kamura Village, and we still haven't settled who's really top dog. Hmph! You're not the only one who's gotten stronger. Today's the day! This snowball fight decides which of us—CATAPULT! I'LL NIP YOU FOR AMBUSHING ME!

title: Greeting
original: Doctor! Meow's the time for a hunt!

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, as a token of a-purr-eciation for looking after us, Yoshitsune and I made you a portion of super-sumptuous Kamura-style Bunny Dango! It's a refinement on Yomogi's secret recipe, guaranteed to fill you with so much pep, you could work for nine lives straight! You what? You'll pass on it? Pardon?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: It seems the 'curse' that spread across Houei exists on Terra too. If we can furst figure out the secret of that 'curse', it's paw-ssible we might find a way home again! Think about that, another trip to Houei! It'd blow Popukar's party away to meet their own selves, I'd bet my tail on it!
